input.unit: FinalChunk collection of one source from the chunking stage (chunk_source); the parser is never re-run

embedding.alignment_rule: model_repo_id and model_revision must equal the chunking contract tokenizer and embedding_handoff values
embedding.runtime_download: forbidden; weights and tokenizer load from BIZAID_DOCLING_ARTIFACTS_PATH with local_files_only and a missing artifact fails before inference
embedding.truncation: forbidden; a text longer than max_length tokens fails instead of being cut

dense.pooling: CLS token of the last hidden state

embedding.reuse: FinalChunks sharing a content_key are embedded once per run

identity.embedding_key: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON of embedding_key_inputs
identity.embedding_config_sha256: SHA-256 of the embedding section of this contract
identity.rule: a model, revision, artifact, inference setting or runtime version change yields a new embedding_key and therefore a new collection; vectors of different embedding keys never share a collection
identity.runtime_version_rule: torch_version and transformers_version are public PEP 440 versions: a local label such as +cpu is dropped (2026-10-03, IMP-017) because the query container installs the CPU-only torch build of the same release; the host pipeline versions carry no label so existing embedding keys do not change

qdrant.server: dev Compose service qdrant (qdrant/qdrant:v1.19.1) on 127.0.0.1:6333; QDRANT_URL may override but only a loopback host or, inside Compose, exactly http://qdrant:6333 (2026-10-03 user decision, IMP-017) is accepted; every other host is qdrant_url_not_loopback
qdrant.collection_name: bizaid_chunks_v{schema_version}_{embedding_key[:12]} (V1, baseline-only, frozen) or bizaid_{namespace}_chunks_v{schema_version}_{embedding_key[:12]} (namespace ^[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,15}$, e.g. v2 service scope)

collection_namespace.read: QDRANT_COLLECTION_NAMESPACE setting (empty = V1); V1 baseline evaluation pins V1
collection_namespace.write: indexing entry points require a namespace; the V1 collection is never written again
collection_namespace.service_scope_v2: documents of active programs that are not CLOSED (OPEN, UPCOMING, UNKNOWN dates) by application_start_date/application_end_date; MySQL and S3 keep every program

qdrant.schema_rule: an existing collection is reused only when its dense and sparse vector configuration, payload index types and collection metadata (schema_version, embedding_key, embedding_model) equal this contract; a mismatch fails and the collection is never recreated or altered implicitly; missing payload indexes are added
qdrant.payload: FinalChunk.payload() (includes embedding_model, pblanc_id, source, parse_key, chunk identity and provenance) plus embedding_key
qdrant.idempotency: upserting the same chunk_id overwrites the same point; re-running a source never duplicates points
qdrant.stale_rule: after the current chunks of a source are upserted, points of that source whose id is not a current chunk_id are deleted (older parse or chunk results, removed announcement relations); the index is derived data and S3 artifacts and MySQL rows are untouched

document_role.purpose: record what kind of document a chunk comes from (announcement body, application form, list) so that cases-v2 can measure whether blank forms crowd out body evidence (IMP-004 type risk)
document_role.ranking: not used for search ranking, filtering or eligibility evidence selection until a decision after cases-v2 evaluation
document_role.identity: not an input of parse_key, chunk_set_key, chunk_id, embedding_text or embedding_key; this top-level section is outside the hashed contract sections (embedding, chunker)
document_role.existing_points: the 61,335 V2 points and all PDF / HWP / HWPX points indexed before 2026-10-02 have no document_role field and are read as UNKNOWN; they are not re-indexed for this field; points indexed before a rule revision keep the role written at indexing time (payloads are not rewritten)
document_role.attach_stage: set on the payload by chunking (ChunkSource.document_role from the source format and original filenames) from the image OCR stage (2026-10-02); existing points are not re-indexed for this field
document_role.rule: normalize every original filename (NFC, lower case, whitespace removed); each filename gets the first role in priority order FORM > LIST > BODY that matches a filename cue or a qualified cue (the qualified cue only counts when one of its with_any words is also in the name), otherwise the format default; when the filenames of one source disagree the role is UNKNOWN
document_role.format_default_basis: image attachments are posters or announcement captures (2026-10-02-imp009-unsupported-formats.md samples); every other format defaults to UNKNOWN
rule_revisions: 2026-10-03 (user decision, stage 4 generic ZIP): 제출서류 is no longer a FORM cue on its own (guidance names such as 선정심사 기준 및 제출 서류 안내 were FORM); 제출서류 with 목록 / 체크리스트 is LIST and with 안내 / 기준 is BODY; FORM cues 결과보고서, 상세서, 조사서, 프로필 added (평가표 is not a FORM cue because evaluation tables carry selection criteria)
